result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the bottom navigation is cramped against the system home indicator and one favorite button has inconsistent, low-contrast styling.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the system home indicator, and the middle navigation icons appear misaligned or partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding to the navigation bar so the icons and labels sit above the home indicator.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the lower pizza card sits on a dark brown circle that appears to blend into the image, giving inconsistent treatment compared with the heart on the ramen card.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent heart button background, such as a white or translucent circular badge, across all cards.
